intro: Rebuild an argument with its thesis, objection, concession and conclusion. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Rebuild an argument with its thesis, objection, concession and conclusion. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: « Certes » grants a point; « néanmoins » introduces a limit and « dès lors » signals a consequence. In this passage, «abonnement» means «subscription».

frases.estudio: La ville envisage un abonnement unique qui donnerait accès aux bus, aux tramways et aux vélos partagés.
frases.alumno: The city is considering a single pass that would give access to buses, trams and shared bicycles.

frases.estudio: Certes, la formule simplifierait les déplacements et pourrait réduire l'usage de la voiture dans le centre.
frases.alumno: Admittedly, the scheme would simplify journeys and could reduce car use in the centre.

frases.estudio: Néanmoins, le tarif proposé reste élevé pour les ménages qui n'utilisent les transports qu'occasionnellement.
frases.alumno: Nevertheless, the proposed fare remains high for households that use public transport only occasionally.

frases.estudio: Dès lors, les associations demandent une option à la journée et une réduction selon le revenu.
frases.alumno: That is why the associations are asking for a daily option and a reduction based on income.
